attchmntText: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
voiceSummary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited intimates the incorporation of GFCL EV Critical Minerals Limited on 12th November, 2026. The new entity is a wholly-owned subsidiary of GFCL EV Products Limited, a material subsidiary of the listed company. GFCL EV Critical Minerals Limited was incorporated in India with a capital of Rs. 1 lakh. GFCL EV Products Limited holds 100% shareholding in the new subsidiary through cash consideration. The new company operates in the battery chemicals industry. Its business activities include manufacturing, trading, importing, exporting, processing, and providing solutions for the entire value chain of battery types, components, and products for electric vehicles. This includes lithium-ion batteries and related products. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for the incorporation.

attchmntText: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited has intimated its participation in investor conferences. Representatives will attend the JM Financial Annual India Conference India Xchange 2026 on 16th November, 2026, in Mumbai. They will also attend the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on 17th November, 2026, in Mumbai. These meetings are of the group or one on one type. An investor presentation on financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, will be shared at these events. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed. The schedule may change due to exigencies. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
